lead.headline: AB81 alone at 7-1, or a three-way tie
lead.dek: One game tonight decides first place, fourth place and the champ’s season. AB81 needs 40.75. Poochinski needs 34.91. deeboliciouskins needs 23.87. Not all of them are chasing wins.
lead.pull: 40.75. 34.91. 23.87. Three numbers, seven starters, one game.
body: Nothing moved overnight. AB81 still has 81.98, the champ still has a final 122.72, and the live odds still read 52.1% AB81. What the sleep did was clear up how much is riding on tonight’s 5:15 PM Pacific kickoff. Everybody has been staring at one number. There are three, and two of them belong to teams that are about to lose.

Start at the top. AB81 needs 40.75 from Sam Darnold and Jaxon Smith-Njigba to reach 7-1 and own first place by itself. Miss, and it’s a three-way tie at 6-2 with Poochinski and Bad things man bad things. Then the fall gets ugly. The Report’s standings break ties on points for, and a losing AB81 tops out at 1,231.44. Poochinski already has 1,297.14. Bad things man bad things has 1,332.04. That’s first place to third place in one evening.

That’s where the second number comes in. Poochinski has 98.7 and isn’t catching Bad things man bad things’ 181.84, but it isn’t done mattering. Caleb Williams, Luther Burden III and the Seattle Seahawks D/ST project for 35.39. They need 34.91 to pass Bad things man bad things on points. So the team sitting on its couch at 181.84, finished, can land in first place tonight without a single player on the field. It needs AB81 to fall short and Poochinski’s trio to stop under that line. Poochinski’s blowout loss has a tiebreak attached. Only in this league.

AB81’s version of the math is simple and terrifying. If Darnold hits his 16.28, Smith-Njigba needs 24.47. If Smith-Njigba hits his 25.26, Darnold needs 15.49. Last week Smith-Njigba scored 31.3 and carried a lineup with three empty slots to a win, so nobody should bet against him out of principle. The enemy tonight is the short field goal. Every Jason Myers kick is good news for deeboliciouskins and a drive AB81 wanted in the end zone.

My pick stays AB81, because the projection clears the bar by 0.79 and because this franchise has spent eight weeks refusing to lose the games it should. But I wouldn’t lay a dollar on it. The champ has played its whole game and has no one left to help itself. It gets to spend the night watching the same offense as everybody else, with a season attached. The weekly edition settles all of it tonight, as soon as the last whistle blows.

quick_hits.headline: Poochinski’s D/ST plays against Poochinski’s quarterback
quick_hits.body: The trio chasing 34.91 is at war with itself: Caleb Williams and Luther Burden III on one sideline, the Seattle Seahawks D/ST on the other. Every Williams touchdown takes from the defense, and every sack takes from Williams. Poochinski needs the shootout where Chicago scores and Seattle’s defense still makes a play. It projects for exactly enough, 0.48 over the line.

quick_hits.headline: Cherry Blossom passes deeboliciouskins unless Swift and Myers deliver
quick_hits.body: Cherry Blossom’s 198.54 did more than all but seal a fourth straight win. It put the team at 1,324.78 on points, and both teams should be 4-4 by morning. deeboliciouskins sits at 1,300.92 and needs 23.87 from D’Andre Swift and Jason Myers to stay ahead. They project for 21.75, or 2.12 short. deeboliciouskins came into the week second in the league in points. It may end Week 8 fifth in the standings.

quick_hits.headline: The champ’s cushion is one Monday game
quick_hits.body: Six teams make the playoffs, and the real fight is for the last spot. Maye I touch your TDs? came into the week at 77.7% and Big Stric Energy at 17.3%. Big Stric Energy’s 181.48 ended six straight losses and got it to 2-6. If AB81 clears 40.75, the champ joins it at 2-6, ahead by 53.02 on points. If AB81 falls short, the champ is 3-5 with a full game of air.

quick_hits.headline: Santa Clara’s Finest has a Lamar decision coming
quick_hits.body: Lamar Jackson’s 0.0 came with an Out tag and a thumb injury, and he’s on Sleeper’s most-dropped list this morning at 73,280. Santa Clara’s Finest, now 1-7 and 1,102.52 on points, has no other quarterback on the bench in a league that starts two. Joe Burrow’s 42.48 can’t do this alone. Expect the wire to be the first stop this week.

quick_hits.headline: The wire’s loudest names are all still free
quick_hits.body: Sleeper’s crowd is chasing Devin Singletary at 548,946 adds, Adonai Mitchell at 471,128, Tyler Allgeier at 268,455 and Ryan Flournoy at 236,008. None of them is on a R.A.T.S. roster yet. Claims process Wednesday, and Tuesday’s brief sets up who should claim whom. Santa Clara’s Finest goes on the early list.

w8-m1.headline: Big Stric Energy wins, 181.48 to 136.48
w8-m1.blurb: Final. Six straight losses, over. Santa Clara’s Finest falls to 1-7.

w8-m2.blurb: The win isn’t coming from a trio projecting for 35.39. But 34.91 passes Bad things man bad things on points.

w8-m3.headline: Swift and Myers play for fourth place
w8-m3.blurb: Cherry Blossom’s 198.54 stands. deeboliciouskins needs 60.76 to win and 23.87 to stay ahead on points.

w8-m4.headline: 40.75 for first place alone
w8-m4.blurb: The champ is final at 122.72. AB81 has 81.98 and projects to 123.52. 52.1% AB81.
